native_and_candidate_decoder: native_model.py, fail-closed opcode subset; instructions are loaded from existing hash-verified targets or freshly relocated IDO objects, never embedded
float_semantics: IEEE binary32 rounding after each native operation; truncation only in finite signed32 representable range. Host compiler disables FMA contraction. Models compare ordered halfword stores including all256 output-alias partitions.
sanitizers: AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer and float-cast-overflow; C89 pedantic-errors, Wall/Wextra/Werror
leak_sanitizer: Only leak detection disabled for executor ptrace incompatibility; no candidate or harness heap allocation.
limits: Valid aligned output pointers may alias one another. They must not alias read-only external data. Full32-bit volume/aux values are clamped; tested pan/span are0..800000 inclusive. External data are finite synthetic fixtures chosen to keep float-to-int conversion representable. Actual external values, nondefault FCSR modes, malformed objects, NaNs/infinities/out-of-range conversion, concurrency, game integration and cartridge behavior are not proved.
